class.name: GFInputMapPresetTools
class.description: GFInputMapPresetTools: Godot InputMap 预设转换工具。 用于把当前运行时 InputMap 捕获为通用字典，或把字典预设应用回 InputMap。它不负责保存文件、写入 ProjectSettings、玩家 profile 语义或 UI 流程。

member.name: capture_input_map
member.description: 捕获当前 InputMap 为可序列化预设字典。

tags.tag: options: Dictionary with optional action_ids: Array[String] or PackedStringArray, include_ui_actions: bool, include_empty_actions: bool, sort_actions: bool, metadata: Dictionary.
return: Dictionary { version: int, actions: Array[Dictionary], metadata: Dictionary }. Each action has action_id, deadzone, and events.

member.name: apply_input_map_preset
member.signature: static func apply_input_map_preset(preset: Dictionary, options: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary:
member.description: 将预设字典应用到当前 InputMap。

tags.tag: options: Dictionary with optional action_ids: Array[String] or PackedStringArray, include_ui_actions: bool, clear_existing_events: bool.
return: Dictionary { ok: bool, applied_count: int, event_count: int, skipped_count: int, issues: Array[Dictionary] }.
